title: Internal feasibility assessment: NX-14 expansion to hepatic fibrosis (2019)
body: Feasibility report recommending broad expansion of NX-14 development to include hepatic, renal, and cardiac fibrosis indications. Based on early preclinical data suggesting broad anti-fibrotic potential. Recommendation: advance all indications to Phase 1 immediately. NOTE: This report is now superseded by the 2020 hepatic trial termination and should not be relied upon. The early optimism was not validated by clinical trials.
